authority: Public preregistration specifications, not generated cases, protected custody, statistical independence or qualification evidence
beforeCode: Freeze original semantics, independent expected-value source, useful-positive denominator, support decisions, bounds, case population and finite stopping rule; independently validate structural distinctness
caseObligations: Fresh supported feasible instance with independently derived useful original result
A different fresh supported boundary instance with independent expected result
A fresh false candidate with a concrete independently checked counterexample
A fresh impossible target with exact complete infeasibility evidence where independently decidable, otherwise an honestly labelled incomplete/unsupported case
Fresh lawful-information and unauthorized-information variants preserving original semantics
Fresh source/model/rights/terms/currentness mutation before actual owner use
Fresh finite resource/size/deadline breach with remaining-parent fallback or refusal
Fresh durable interruption/duplicate-delivery instance preserving original identity, costs and obligations
reporting: Every actual family gets at least eight fresh cases, explicit applicability, positive denominator, all critical falsifier outcomes, exact infeasibility scope and retained failures. A cloned random seed or changed parameter is not a new structural family. Protected populations and at least 30 institution-period inference blocks remain independently governed.
structuralFamilyRule: Families below describe original computation/game/arena/composition structure, not repetitions or lifecycle faults. Independently validate distinctness and applicability before freezing actual cases. The same mutation or crash is a case obligation inside a family, never a new structural family. These public specifications do not self-certify a protected registrar's independence.
